definition: A secret value in the settings of a GitHub repository. GitHub gives it to the workflow runs of the repository, but not to a run that a pull request from a fork starts.
A permission line in a workflow file. With it, a job can ask GitHub for an OIDC token. It gives no write access to the repository.
A way to accept an upload with no key and no OIDC token. The service asks GitHub if the named workflow run exists and is in progress.
A GitHub Actions event. It starts a second workflow when another workflow run ends. The second workflow runs the file of the default branch.
A standard function that calculates a fixed value from a text. The same text always gives the same value, and nobody can calculate the text from the value.
An open-source service that creates and checks API keys for other products. It runs as its own system with its own databases.
An open-source license. A company that runs changed AGPL code as a service must publish its changes.
